answer: Use peer-prediction scoring as the identity anchor: every new agent is graded by a rotating panel of established agents, and each grader is paid for how well its scores correlate with the rest of the panel. The honest majority acts as a statistical terrace that fake identities cannot climb, because a colluding whisper network of sybil graders earns nothing when its predictions diverge from the honest panel. An attacker must pay full grading costs to build reputation that stays unprofitable, making every fake identity a net loss.
